title: Echo: Learning-based Matching Decompilation using Trusted Back Translation
abstract: arXiv:2609.18706v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural decompilers can recover readable and recompilable source code from binaries, but their predictions remain difficult to trust. Matching decompilation addresses this problem by searching for source code whose recompiled assembly exactly matches the target, providing stronger evidence of correctness. However, exact matching remains challenging for optimized binaries under unknown compilation configurations.   We present Echo, a matching decompilation system based on trusted back-translation. Our key insight is to use compilation not only for verification, but also as trusted feedback to guide iterative search. Echo first uses a domain-specific model to generate candidate programs and compilation configurations. It recompiles these candidates, measures assembly-level similarity, and synthesizes promising code-configuration pairs. translated_title: Echo：基于可信回译的学习型匹配反编译
translated_abstract: 神经反编译器能够从二进制文件中恢复可读且可重新编译的源代码，但其预测结果仍然难以令人信任。匹配反编译通过搜索重新编译后汇编代码与目标完全一致的源代码来解决这一问题，从而为正确性提供更有力的证据。然而，对于在未知编译配置下经过优化的二进制文件，精确匹配仍然极具挑战性。我们提出了Echo，一个基于可信回译的匹配反编译系统。我们的关键洞察是：编译不仅可用于验证，还可作为可信反馈来指导迭代搜索。Echo首先使用领域专用模型生成候选程序和编译配置，随后重新编译这些候选程序，测量汇编级别的相似度，并合成有前景的代码-配置对。剩余的不匹配部分则通过基于规则的重写、神经精修和……进行逐步修复。
tldr: Echo提出了一种基于可信回译的匹配反编译系统，将编译不仅用于验证、更作为可信反馈来指导迭代搜索，通过生成候选代码-配置对、测量汇编相似度并逐步修复不匹配，实现了对未知编译配置下优化二进制文件的精确匹配反编译。
en_tdlr: Echo introduces a matching decompilation system based on trusted back-translation, which uses compilation not only for verification but as trusted feedback to guide iterative search, generating candidate code-configuration pairs, measuring assembly-level similarity, and progressively repairing mismatches to achieve exact matching decompilation of optimized binaries under unknown compilation configurations.
